title: Conformal Map Visualization of f(z) = z^2
full_prompt: Create a Manim scene named `MoreComplicatedExamples1` that visualizes the conformal mapping $f(z) = z^2$ using two side-by-side complex planes. First, display the formula $f(z) = z^2$ in a large font with 'f' colored pink and 'z' colored yellow, surrounded by a black stroke. Next, transition this formula to the top of the right plane while introducing two complex planes side-by-side: an input plane on the left and an output plane on the right, both ranging from -4 to 4 on both axes. Add coordinate labels to both planes. Create a fine grid of squares on the input plane. Then, perform three point-by-point evaluations: $f(2) = 4$, $f(i) = -1$, and $f(-1) = 1$. For each evaluation, show a glowing dot appearing on the input plane, write the corresponding equation, and animate a copy of the dot traveling along a curved path (using a negative arc) to its mapped position on the output plane. Finally, fade out these point evaluations to prepare for the full grid transformation.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect coordinate conversion between screen space and complex plane space using p2n and n2p
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the correct plane instance is used for converting points to complex numbers and vice versa.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing custom classes TrueDot or GlowDot in standard Manim environments
common_failure_modes.note: If running on standard Manim Community, replace TrueDot and GlowDot with standard Dot and overlapping semi-transparent larger dots for the glow effect.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Grid interpolation issues when applying non-linear functions
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the grid has enough curve points (using insert_n_curves or similar) so that the transformation z^2 looks smooth and curved rather than jagged.
